fundamentals.name: Salesforce, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Salesforce, Inc. provides customer relationship management technology services that connect companies and customers together in the United States, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. The company offers Agentforce, which enables customers to build, deploy, and manage enterprise-grade, autonomous AI agents at scale, enabling humans and agents to work together; Agentforce Sales, an integrated platform that brings together the power of humans with AI agents to help sales teams for selling, managing, and automating entire sales processes; Agentforce Service, which enables companies in every industry to bring all of their customer, employee, IT, and field service needs onto one integrated AI-powered platform; Data 360, a data engine that gives AI agents their context and serves as the foundation for how customers unify service offerings, making their data actionable for both humans and agents; Informatica, an AI-powered data management platform that enables customers to discover, integrate, govern, and deliver trusted data at scale across hybrid and multi-cloud environments; and Slack, a conversational interface for the agentic enterprise where people and agents work together, connecting knowledge, actions, and data in real time. It also provides marketing platforms; commerce services, which empower shopping experiences across various customer touchpoints; integration and analytics solutions; Salesforce Starter, a suite for small and medium-sized businesses that brings sales, service, marketing, and commerce together; and a field service solution that enables companies to connect service agents, dispatchers, and mobile employees through one centralized platform to schedule and dispatch work, as well as track and manage jobs. It serves financial services, healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, automotive, and government sectors. Salesforce, Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

judgment.summary: Salesforce demonstrates robust growth and profitability, supported by strong free cash flow, though it carries a significant debt load.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimates by 24.1% (EPS 3.88 vs 3.13); next earnings date is 2026-09-02.
positives: Revenue growth of 13.3% YoY and earnings growth of 52.2% YoY indicate strong business expansion.
Profit margin of 18.7% and operating margin of 21.8% reflect healthy profitability.
Free cash flow of $16.55B TTM is substantial and supports operations and shareholder returns.
Forward P/E of 11.29x is attractive relative to trailing P/E of 20.33x and PEG ratio of 0.90.
Analyst consensus is a strong buy with a high mean target price.
negatives: Debt/Equity ratio of 124.28% is high, indicating significant leverage.
Current ratio of 0.79 and quick ratio of 0.61 suggest potential short-term liquidity challenges.
Recent acquisition of M3ter and AI competition may introduce integration risks and impact future margins.

news.paragraph: Salesforce (CRM) is navigating a complex landscape, with recent reports highlighting pressure from AI competition and a significant acquisition of M3ter to bolster its AI pricing models. While the company recently beat Q1 earnings estimates by a substantial margin, the stock saw a decline following the M3ter acquisition news, signaling potential investor concerns about the strategic shift. The market is weighing the impact of these developments on future growth and competitive positioning.
